goal: Stripe charge webhook metadata'sını payment_intent kimliği ve tam/kısmi refund sınıflandırmasıyla canonical inbox kaydına almak
rollback: Bu paketin Stripe webhook extraction ve test değişikliklerini geri al; inbox, payment, invoice, document veya delivery verisini silme veya resetleme
acceptance: Stripe charge refund/dispute records use payment_intent as the canonical payment identity when present and never fall back to charge ID for order matching
charge.refunded metadata distinguishes full and partial refund only from bounded amount_refunded and amount values
Missing correlation or refund classification remains safely non-mutating; raw provider payload and secrets are not persisted
Existing signature verification, inbox idempotency and non-charge webhook extraction remain unchanged
